title: Before the Sun Burned Bright (Yahwe the faithful one)
content:
Lied auf Youtube anhören.

Before the sun burn bright and rivers flowed,
I call you each by name to share My home.
No longer be afraid;
you are my son.
My love will never end,
Alleluia.

Though you have sent me, Lord, to every land,
I can’t find words to speak
Your ways of love.

Before the sun burn bright and rivers flowed,
I call you each by name to share My home.
No longer be afraid;
you are my son.
My love will never end,
Alleluia.

The Lord reached out His hand
and touched my tongue.
I give my words to you
to speak my love.

Before the sun burn bright and rivers flowed,
I call you each by name to share My home.
No longer be afraid;
you are my son.
My love will never end,
Alleluia.

My hand will bring your words,
so speak them loud.
I am your Lord and God;
the fithful one.

Before the sun burn bright and rivers flowed,
I call you each by name to share My home.
No longer be afraid;
you are my son.
My love will never end,
Alleluia.
